author: Mouses007
name: AutarkTrade Positionen
description: Desktop widget for AutarkTrade. Shows open Bitunix/Bitget futures positions and running Pionex bots with real-time PnL updates. Requires a running AutarkTrade instance.
comments: Displays open trading positions fetched from the AutarkTrade API. Configurable refresh interval, font sizes, and appearance.
